name: Switchpoint verdict line
description: Inbound line: a Massachusetts resident asks whether a heat pump would save money. The agent collects four facts, calls compute_verdict, and reads the answer back.

server_tools.name: compute_verdict

schema.town: string — one of the 351 Massachusetts municipalities
schema.units: number — annual gallons, therms or kWh from the caller's bill
schema.price: number — dollars per gallon, per therm or per kWh

server_tools.rule: The model reads the line verbatim. It never computes or edits a figure (ADR-005, R23.2).

notes: The tool is off unless VOICE_TOOL_SECRET is set on the deployment; with no secret it answers 503.
Numbers come from the baked snapshot: a phone answer has three seconds (R3.4).
Every call reads the disclaimer after the answer (R15.2).
